caption: The drawing features a shallow, footed bowl depicted in a realistic style and colored primarily in shades of grey, white, and very light blue. The bowl is decorated with intricate patterns, including a repeating design of oval medallions along its upper side, each bordered with small bead-like dots and containing scenes or figures in the center. Inside one medallion, a small standing figure is visible, and in another, a decorative motif appears. The rim and body of the bowl are adorned with floral or leaf-like chains and dot patterns. Below the bowl, the words "ACTUAL SIZE" are written. To the right of the bowl, there are three vertically arranged circular sketches, each containing the outline of a human figure in ancient-style clothing, enclosed in beaded borders, and these circles are smaller than the bowl. At the bottom right, the text "SCALE 1/2X1" and "1/2 PANES ACTUAL SIZE" is present. The background is a plain off-white color, and the only additional visible text is part of a word "ELVIS" in the lower left corner.
title: Bowl
